description: Open roles on one company's public Workday career site (pass tenant, wd number and site name from its careers URL, e.g. salesforce / 12 / External_Career_Site). Title, location text, posting text (e.g. 'Posted Today'), requisition id, and link. Workday's public list has no salary or company name field; the link is built from the site address and the posting path. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

site.description: Career site name from the URL path, e.g. External_Career_Site

tenant.description: Workday tenant name from the careers host, e.g. salesforce

wd.description: Workday data-centre number from the host (wd1 ... wd12), e.g. 12

name: jobs_workday_jobs
title: Jobs Workday Jobs
